name: @agentboster/sdk
description: Cross-tier SDK for the AgentBoster platform: unifies public types and contracts across the CLI runtime, the Web HTTP API, the Workflow DevKit, the Desktop IPC bridge, and the agentd tool protocol.

scripts.regen-all: python3 scripts/regen-stubs.py && python3 scripts/regen-exports.py && python3 scripts/regen-web.py && python3 scripts/regen-workflow.py && python3 scripts/regen-desktop.py && python3 scripts/regen-agentd.py
scripts.build: echo 'SDK ships as TypeScript source — no build step. The runtime (jiti) compiles on load.' && exit 0
